question_record.context: An incident started with a suspicious sequence of exploration activities where certain windows commands were executed by a process. This process likely belongs to an attacker trying to identify valuable assets and coordinate lateral movement. Later, a process was injected with potentially malicious code, indicating malicious activity. The investigation progressed to email messages containing malicious URLs being removed after delivery.
question_record.question: What is the mailbox primary address associated with the email messages containing the malicious URL that were removed after delivery?
solution: A suspicious sequence of exploration activities was observed executed by the process `powershell.exe`.
A user with AadUserId `a2d0f7c2-b0a0-43bd-bce0-27d8ae3be4d0` had a process injected with potentially malicious code.
Email messages containing a malicious URL were removed from the mailbox `bjenkins@niseko.alpineskihouse.co` after delivery.

52.name: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities
52.description: A process called a set of windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers in order to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine.

41.name: A process was injected with potentially malicious code
41.description:
A process has injected code into another process, indicating suspicious code being run in the target process memory. Injection is often used to hide malicious code execution within a trusted process. 
As a result, the target process may exhibit abnormal behaviors such as opening a listening port or connecting to a command and control server.

JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
